Monsoon Withdrawal Expected in India, Weather Changes Noted

The monsoon season in India is nearing its end, with withdrawal potentially occurring within three days. Weather patterns are shifting, with dry conditions expected in Punjab starting today. Temperatures are forecast to remain near normal, though cooler mornings and evenings are anticipated. In Gwalior, before the monsoon's departure, there is a possibility of showers for the next four days, with a rise in temperature potentially bringing back humidity.
